notes:
### 1. Product Overview
Slack is a cloud-based team communication and collaboration platform. It enables teams to work together via public and private channels, direct messaging, voice and video calls (huddles), and collaborative documents (canvases) and lists.
* **Source URL:** `https://slack.com/intl/en-in/pricing`
* **Verbatim Quote:** `"channels chat and work together slack connect work with external partners meetings & video video chat with your team canvas create, edit and share docs lists manage projects in slack"`

### 2. Authentication Methods
The Slack public API supports multiple authentication methods:
* **OAuth 2.0:** Used for installing apps into workspaces and obtaining bot or user access tokens.
  * **Source URL:** `https://docs.slack.dev/reference/methods/oauth.v2.access/`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"Exchanges a temporary OAuth verifier code for an access token."`
* **OpenID Connect:** Used specifically for user authentication and identity verification ("Sign in with Slack").
  * **Source URL:** `https://docs.slack.dev/authentication/sign-in-with-slack/`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `{"keys":[{"e":"aqab","n":"zqqzxfb677bpmkw0idkc5wkvlyqk04pwmswyjdkqmuuuu_pmzdsvxbfhu7tczinohduvvgdqjqnklpezjxnazy0dddhvjks0ji8fkxifv1kny3dkpqmmhgawnftuisxgb5clypomotaem59ghpyjk9jhbwohs14nyeyzv9nvy0ekjauyydstz589aiku5la-cepg93jnqlw8a82kftlrj1iijo2isybganr0yzr-d3b_5evp7ivu7ph2v5jceuheilsrzizp3puyvfrph659deh-uasdfoyjbicimg9itnk5_45sb_xcd_un6h5i7tgoafajn4oi4aagd4elni_k1q","kty":"rsa","kid":"mb2mayksn555isd0ebdhkx6nkyai9xlq8rvceb_noyy","alg":"rs256"}]}` *(from the associated keys endpoint `https://slack.com/openid/connect/keys`)*
* **Bearer Tokens:** Static bot (`xoxb-`) or user (`xoxp-`) tokens passed in the HTTP Authorization header for API requests.
  * **Source URL:** `https://hexdocs.pm/slack_open_api/0.0.3/SlackOpenApi.html`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"export SLACK_BOT_TOKEN=\"xoxb-your-bot-token-here\""`

* **Primary Auth for Multi-Tenant Integration:** `oauth2`. A multi-tenant integration platform would utilize Slack's standard OAuth 2.0 flow to allow external workspaces to authorize the app and securely exchange authorization codes for access tokens.

### 3. Developer Credentials & Cost
* **Access Tier:** `self_serve_free`
* **How to get credentials & Cost:** Any developer can sign up for a free Slack account or request a dedicated developer sandbox at no cost. Credentials (Client ID and Client Secret) are obtained instantly by creating an app via the Slack App Management dashboard.
  * **Source URL:** `https://docs.slack.dev/quickstart/`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"if you don't have a slack workspace already, we recommend also setting up a developer sandbox ."`
  * **Source URL:** `https://zenzap.co/blog/slack-pricing-guide`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"Free Plan: $0 ... Small teams testing Slack"`
* **Approval Requirements:** No upfront approval or partner program is required to create an app, obtain credentials, or install it to a development workspace. However, if the developer intends to publicly list the app in the Slack Marketplace for all Slack users, it must undergo a manual review process.
  * **Source URL:** `https://docs.slack.dev/apps/marketplace/review-guide`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"The review itself consists of the Slack Marketplace Team checking your app against our guidelines."`

### 4. API Style & Technical Characteristics
* **API Style:** REST-like Web API (uses HTTP methods, typically POST with JSON or URL-encoded bodies).
  * **Source URL:** `https://github.com/slackapi/slack-api-specs`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"covers user and bot user token usage of public Web API methods"`
* **API Breadth:** Extremely broad. It covers hundreds of endpoints across methods, events, and scopes, including messaging, channels, files, canvases, lists, and administration.
  * **Source URL:** `https://docs.slack.dev/reference/`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"slack apps can utilize a wide range of apis and platform features to accomplish their tasks. within this section contains a collection of reference guides for those features"`
* **OpenAPI Spec:** Yes, Slack officially maintains an OpenAPI 2.0 specification for its Web API and an AsyncAPI specification for its Events API.
  * **Source URL:** `https://github.com/slackapi/slack-api-specs`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"OpenAPI 2.0 spec - covers user and bot user token usage of public Web API methods"`
* **Webhooks:** Supported. Slack provides both Incoming Webhooks (for posting messages) and the Events API (which pushes real-time event webhooks to a developer's server).
  * **Source URL:** `https://docs.slack.dev/reference/`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"browse our ensemble of events to enlighten and elucidate the comings and goings in your slack workspace."`
* **Sandbox:** Yes, Slack officially provides free developer sandboxes for testing.
  * **Source URL:** `https://docs.slack.dev/quickstart/`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"if you don't have a slack workspace already, we recommend also setting up a developer sandbox ."`

### 5. Model Context Protocol (MCP) Support
* **MCP Availability:** `official`
* **Details:** Slack officially publishes and hosts a Slack MCP server/plugin designed to connect AI coding agents and tools directly to a Slack workspace.
  * **Source URL:** `https://docs.slack.dev/quickstart/`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"try using the slack mcp plugin to aid in agent-assisted development."`
  * **Source URL:** `https://github.com/slackapi/slack-mcp-plugin`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"The Slack MCP and Skills Plugin for AI tools bundles together a set of skills that help you develop on the Slack platform with the Slack MCP Server."`

### 6. Buildability Verdict
* **Verdict:** `ready_now`
* **Main Blocker:** None. The platform provides completely self-serve free credentials, comprehensive documentation, official OpenAPI specifications, and an official MCP server, making it fully ready for immediate toolkit deployment.
